words: Rulings on B-cy8f's questions. (1) Shaft density: yes. Nick's approved recommendation was 'dark gray on top, lighter underneath, a bit furrier', so more strands and tufted edge lift on the shaft are in scope. (2) Method change for the pale line: the line is skin highlight through the remaining gaps, so the skin under the shaft takes the local fur root color and a matte finish; density alone was shown not to change the read at 2x (B-ajd4, B-5mg8). (3) The plume tufts rooted on the shaft stay held (Nick 10-21, 10-24, and N-vsx4 keeps the plume); the three-quarter station is plume territory and drops out of the tone gate. (4) The quarter station's lighter underside from the long root blend is accepted; the short blend left a step in flight frames f19 to f22. (5) The toe-base glint (D-3d96) goes into the same preview build: name the surface that makes it first; if it is skin under fur, the same matte fur-colored skin fix applies to the foot's furred area with pads and claws excluded; if it is a pad or claw, leave it and report.
